mapper.select: SELECT FROM flow_routing r JOIN flow_instance i ON i.id = r.instance_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=flow_instance, alias=i) */ AND r.instance_id = #{instanceId} ORDER BY r.seq ASC
SELECT FROM flow_routing r JOIN flow_instance i ON i.id = r.instance_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=flow_instance, alias=i) */ AND r.instance_id = #{instanceId} ORDER BY r.seq DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM flow_routing r JOIN flow_instance i ON i.id = r.instance_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=flow_instance, alias=i) */ AND r.instance_id = #{instanceId} AND r.action_type = 'rollback' AND r.status = 'processing' AND r.to_node_seq = #{toNodeSeq} ORDER BY r.seq DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM flow_routing r JOIN flow_instance i ON i.id = r.instance_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=flow_instance, alias=i) */ AND r.instance_id = #{instanceId} AND r.to_dept_id = #{toDeptId} AND r.action_type IN ('route', 'back_home')

SELECT FROM flow_routing r JOIN flow_instance i ON i.id = r.instance_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=flow_instance, alias=i) */ AND r.instance_id = #{instanceId} ORDER BY r.seq DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flow_routing (instance_id, seq, action_type, from_dept_id, to_dept_id, from_node_seq, to_node_seq, designated_by, reason, status, finished_at) VALUES (#{instanceId}, #{seq}, #{actionType}, #{fromDeptId}, #{toDeptId}, #{fromNodeSeq}, #{toNodeSeq}, #{designatedBy}, #{reason}, IFNULL(#{status}, 'processing'), #{finishedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE flow_routing SET status = 'finished', finished_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'processing'
